version.changelog: Explain API key setup and first run, with safe task follow-up.

llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward guide for using AceDataCloud's Hailuo video API, with expected API-token and network-use requirements disclosed.

dimensions.detail: Network transmission to api.acedata.cloud is necessary for a hosted video-generation API, and the examples send only generation prompts, model choices, optional image URLs, and the bearer token.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill tells users to install @acedatacloud/hailuo and verify the publisher, and it requires placing an API token in ~/.openclaw/.env; this credential setup is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to setup, authentication, generation requests, and polling; there are no prompt overrides, hidden agent directives, broad file access, or unrelated workflows.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The only persistent element described is storing ACEDATACLOUD_API_TOKEN in an OpenClaw .env file; no services, hooks, scheduled tasks, tool wrappers, or persistent agent behavior are installed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is AI video generation through AceDataCloud Hailuo, and the documented API calls, prompts, model parameters, and image URL options directly support that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use AceDataCloud's hosted Hailuo API. Treat the API key as a secret, restrict allowed APIs where possible, expect prompts and image URLs you submit to be sent to AceDataCloud, and watch for billable generation requests before retrying.
llm.findings:
[PE3] expected: The .env reference is documentation for storing the user-provided AceDataCloud API token, not artifact code reading arbitrary credential files; the skill also warns not to put the key in prompts or commit the .env file.
[E1] expected: The external POST to https://api.acedata.cloud/hailuo/videos is the disclosed service call required for the advertised video-generation function; the duplicate E1 signal points to the same expected API transmission.
